description: Registered commands on the machine that holds the dedicated checkouts (one per repo and flow, <root>/<owner>/<name>, used by nothing else; the improvement flow's root and the fix flow's root differ): fetch and reset bring an improvement checkout's local main to origin/main before an associate run (an earlier run's local merge is discarded; its change is already in a configuration PR); fetch-pr and reset-pr bring a fix checkout's local main to a pull request's head, fetched by its pull ref refs/pull/<number>/head into refs/qodo-fix/head (the number is an int argument and the branch name is never passed to git); pause is the poll interval of the run-status loop (a retry_until body has no wait step). Commands run with argv lists, never a shell, in a temporary directory with only PATH and LANG set, so the remote must be fetchable without HOME (for example https for a public repo); otherwise prefix the fetch argv with env HOME=<the node user's home>.
name: Qodo checkouts
